translation.greeting: Hi, I'm Icaro, a full-stack developer.
translation.title: Your digital product, from idea to launch, with me by your side.
translation.description: I build your product end to end: I get to know your business, plan, develop web, mobile and backend, ship it and keep improving it with you. With AI at the center of the process to deliver faster.
translation.portraitCaption: Web, mobile, backend and AI, with the same care.
translation.servicesTitle: From the first sketch to deploy, I take care of the whole product.
translation.servicesDescription: Websites, systems, apps and automations built with the right technology for each challenge: TypeScript and Go, with React, Next.js, React Native, NestJS and Gin.
translation.serviceWebSummary: Company sites, landing pages and e-commerce that open doors.
translation.serviceWebBody: I build fast, accessible websites with React and Next.js (server rendering, static generation and SEO), designed to load in seconds and turn visits into leads.
translation.serviceMobileSummary: Android and iOS apps from a single codebase.
translation.serviceMobileBody: I build React Native apps that deliver the same experience on iOS and Android, with notifications, admin dashboards and integration with your product's APIs.
translation.workDescription: A few of the products I've designed and built for clients and partners.
translation.workCta: I want a project like this
translation.fillInTheForm: Tell me about your idea, even if it's still early. I read every message and will get back to you to talk about the next step.
translation.typeYourMessage: Tell me a bit about the project, timeline and goal.
translation.name: Name
translation.emailSentedSuccess: Message sent. I'll get back to you soon.
translation.emailSendError: The message wasn't sent. Check your connection and try again.
translation.serviceSystemsSummary: Web systems, customer portals and integrations.
translation.serviceSystemsBody: I structure organized, testable backends with NestJS and high-performance APIs in Go with Gin. I integrate with CRMs, payment providers, WhatsApp and the other APIs your business already uses.
translation.serviceSeoSummary: A strategy to be found by the people looking for you.
translation.serviceSeoBody: I take care of the technical foundation (performance, structured data, local SEO) so your site shows up in search and brings in leads consistently.
translation.serviceAutomationSummary: Fewer manual tasks, more clarity to decide.
translation.serviceAutomationBody: I build automations, dashboards and APIs that take repetitive work off your team and put the numbers that matter in front of you.
translation.principlePerformanceBody: Speed isn't a final tweak. It's decided in the architecture, before the first screen.
translation.principleIntegrationBody: What I build plugs into the systems you already use, without rework.
translation.principleClarityBody: Scope, deadlines and approvals in writing. You know what comes at every stage.
translation.principlePartnerBody: Launch is the beginning. I follow the results and plan the next improvements.
translation.processTitle: From start to finish, walking alongside you
translation.processStep1Body: We talk about your idea, your audience and the problem the product needs to solve.
translation.processStep2Body: Together we define scope, priorities and deliverables, with a clear timeline and investment.
translation.processStep3Body: Design and development in short iterations, with you validating the product along the way.
translation.processStep4Body: I ship the product with domain, security and monitoring, ready for its first users.
translation.faq1Q: I already have a website. Can you improve it?
translation.faq1A: Yes. I start with an assessment and tell you whether it's worth improving the current site or rebuilding, and why.
translation.faq2A: First I understand the goal and the integrations you need. The proposal lists stages, timeline and investment. The first conversation is free of commitment.
translation.faq3Q: Do you work with clients outside your city?
translation.faq3A: Yes. I work remotely with clients across Brazil and abroad.
translation.faq4Q: Can it integrate with the tools I already use?
translation.faq4A: In most cases, yes: CRMs, payment providers, WhatsApp and APIs in general. I assess each integration at the start.
translation.faq5Q: Who owns the code at the end?
translation.faq5A: You do. The project, including the code and the accounts in scope, belongs to your company.
translation.faq6A: I offer support, maintenance and ongoing improvements, with the terms set in the proposal.
translation.whatsappMessage: Hi Icaro! I found your portfolio and would like to talk about a project.
translation.serviceAiSummary: Agents, RAG and MCP tools that work with your data.
translation.serviceAiBody: I build assistants and agents that search your company's documents securely, MCP servers that give models like Claude and Copilot access to your tools, and automations that take repetitive work off your team.
translation.aiTitle: I work with AI and build tools for it.
translation.aiIntro: AI sits at both ends of my work: in how I build and in what I deliver.
translation.aiExecBody: I develop with coding agents every day, guided by skills, written plans, tests and automated review. AI speeds up delivery, and the process keeps the code reliable.
translation.aiExecPoint1: Coding agents with my own skills and workflows
translation.aiExecPoint2: AI-assisted planning, testing and code review
translation.aiExecPoint3: More speed without giving up quality
translation.aiBuildTitle: Tools built with and for AI
translation.aiBuildBody: I build the pieces that make AI genuinely useful inside a product or a company.
translation.aiCase1Body: Assistants that search documents securely, respect who can see what and answer citing their sources.
translation.aiCase2Body: Tools that give models like Claude and Copilot controlled access to systems, APIs and data, with authentication and auditing.
translation.aiCase3Body: Skills and workflows for agents that turn repetitive tasks into reliable processes, with evaluation and quality tracking.
translation.aiDemoLabel: Illustrative example of an agent using MCP tools
translation.certsIntro: Ongoing study in software architecture, Go and backend.
translation.processIntro: You don't need to assemble a team or bridge designers, developers and infrastructure. I stay with your product through every stage, so you always know what's happening and what comes next.
translation.processStep5Body: I follow the results with you and we plan the next improvements. Launch is just the beginning.
translation.ctaTitle: Have an idea? Tell me in 2 minutes.
translation.ctaBody: You don't need to have it all figured out. Tell me what you want to build and I'll reply with the next steps, no commitment.
translation.projectType: What do you want to build?
translation.guarantee1Body: The project and the accounts in scope belong to your company.
translation.guarantee2Body: You know what will be delivered and when, before we start.
translation.guarantee3Body: Maintenance and improvements agreed in the proposal.

translation.serviceSeoItem3: Local SEO to show up in your area

translation.aboutTitle: Your project starts with a conversation.
translation.aboutP1: I'm a freelance full-stack developer. When we work together, I'm involved from our first conversations about your business through launch and beyond. I'm the one who gets to know your idea, makes the plan, and writes the code.
translation.aboutP2: AI is part of my daily work: I use coding agents to move faster without giving up quality, and I also build AI agents and tools into the products I deliver.
